component: Manifest, normalized result and impact-selection acceptance audit

strictVersionedManifest: Unknown keys and invalid versions/classes rejected
Duplicate scenario identities/selectors and suite catalog identities rejected
Escaping impact/harness/report paths and NUL argv rejected
Structured adapters require reports; ambiguous multi-scenario exit-only adapter rejected
Frozen suite revisions and distinct model/runner provenance retained
normalizedResult: Exact immutable source/assertion identity and runner image/provider provenance required
Contradictory aggregate status/counts/pass rates and duplicate results rejected
Incomplete/skipped trials and infrastructure errors cannot pass
Actual native/pytest/Promptfoo/DeepEval outputs normalized in mandatory integration
impactSelection: Explicit categories/paths and requirement mapping select suites
Model changes require representative suites/model matrices
Permission/policy changes require policy and adversarial suites
Missing requirement coverage and mandatory class gaps remain explicit

limitations: This acceptance closes only the tracked aggregate contract criterion; full M2 phase/distribution gates remain open.
verifiedCiTestNames: eval contract is strict, immutable and preserves explicit argv including repeated args
eval manifests reject duplicate scenarios, escaping paths and ambiguous exit-code assertions
impact selection includes required tool, model, permission and implementation classes and reports gaps
normalized results cannot hide infrastructure errors, skipped trials, count or identity contradictions
model-impact selection reports missing representative suites and incomplete model matrices
missing tool contracts and permission defenses remain explicit without requirement mappings
